name: Shaurya Aur Anokhi Ki Kahani
description: Shaurya, a male chauvinist who believes that every girl's future belongs in the kitchen, is in for a surprise when he crosses paths with Anokhi, a hardworking girl.

videos.title: The Sabherwals are here
videos.overview: Meet the Sabherwals, a royal family of Chandigarh. As Shaurya Sabherwal gets ready for his engagement with Shagun, he gets unexpected news from her.

videos.title: Rama's Aggressive Reaction
videos.overview: Rama slaps Anokhi when she arrives home late and argues with the family. Elsewhere, the Sabherwals are unable to come to terms with Shagun's decision.

videos.title: Babli Returns Home
videos.overview: Anokhi's elder sister, Babli returns home after getting beaten by her husband. On the other hand, Shagun and her family apologise to the Sabherwals.

videos.title: Anokhi's Narrow Escape
videos.overview: Anokhi manages to sneak away from her house as she aims to win the competition. Meanwhile, Shaurya breaks all ties with Shagun and her family.

videos.title: A Proud Moment for Anokhi
videos.overview: Anokhi wins the trophy on behalf of her college while Shaurya meets Aastha on stage. Later, Aastha recollects her discouraging past with the Sabherwals.

videos.title: Anokhi Defends Aastha
videos.overview: Anokhi supports Aastha when Shaurya behaves rudely with her. On the other hand, Monty and his parents visit the Bhallas to meet Anokhi.

videos.title: Ramesh's Violent Outburst
videos.overview: Ramesh slaps Babli after learning the truth about Anokhi. In a fit of rage, Ramesh crushes Anokhi's cycle and does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Anokhi Remains Adamant
videos.overview: The Bhallas fume in rage when Anokhi remains adamant about pursuing her studies rather than getting married. Meanwhile, Aastha grows concerned for Anokhi.

videos.title: A Shocker for Anokhi
videos.overview: Anokhi learns a shocking truth about Babli while Ramesh humiliates Aastha. Elsewhere, the Sabherwals take an unexpected decision about Shaurya's marriage.

videos.title: Anokhi Rebukes Raja
videos.overview: Ramesh has a shocking outburst while Shaan recalls some fond memories of Aastha. Later, Anokhi rebukes Raja for dropping out of his college.

videos.title: Anokhi Meets Monty
videos.overview: At Shoki's wedding, Monty is unable to take his eyes off Anokhi and tries to start a conversation.

videos.title: Shaurya Berates Shagun
videos.overview: Devi tries to convince Shaurya to attend Shagun's farewell ceremony.

videos.title: Anokhi's Brave Act
videos.overview: Shaurya asks Shagun to rethink her decision of leaving the country for her Ph.D.

videos.title: Anokhi Faces a Dilemma
videos.overview: Anokhi is torn between her dreams and parental pressure about her marriage.

videos.title: Anokhi Puts Forth a Request
videos.overview: Anokhi remains adamant about writing her entrance exams for the Sabherwal Institute.

videos.title: Aastha Advises Anokhi
videos.overview: Aastha gives Anokhi a crucial piece of advice on life after marriage.

videos.title: Anokhi Lands in a Soup
videos.overview: Anokhi is forced to marry Monty despite gathering proof against his misdeeds.

videos.title: Babli Unearths the Truth
videos.overview: Babli comes to know about Monty's true colours from a voice recording on Anokhi's phone.

videos.title: Anokhi's Great Escape
videos.overview: Babli comes up with an idea to save Anokhi from the marriage.

videos.title: Shaan to Start Afresh with Aastha
